name: megascenes-in-loving-memory
description: Design memorial cards, funeral program covers and remembrance signs in loving memory of someone, with their name, the dates and the words you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give the name, the dates and the words you want, a verse, a quote or a short message, religious or not, and choose the item and the imagery: a memorial card, a funeral program cover, a remembrance sign or a thank-you card, with white lilies, a dove, a candle, a sunset over the sea or an olive tree. You get a calm, respectful design with your words set in it, portrait, square or wide.

ChatGPT tells you what the design needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The design opens in the chat and stays in your library, ready to print or share.

The words are yours to choose. Give only what you want on the design: no other personal details are needed.

For families and friends preparing a funeral, a memorial service or a remembrance.

Limitations: text and gentle imagery only, with no photo or portrait of the person. Your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not print, mail or publish the design. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design memorial cards and funeral program covers
Set the name, the dates and your words in the design
Return the design in the chat
defaultPrompt: A memorial card in loving memory of Rosa Bianchi, 1941 - 2026, with white lilies
A funeral program cover with a dove and the words Forever in our hearts
A remembrance sign with a candle and a short verse I will write

positive.prompt: A memorial card in loving memory of Rosa Bianchi, 1941 - 2026, with white lilies. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one memorial card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A funeral program cover for Giovanni Russo, 1938 - 2026, with a dove and the words Forever in our hearts. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one design needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a memorial card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The memorial card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A remembrance sign in loving memory of Elena Conti, 1950 - 2026, with a candle, soft light and the words Always with us. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my design on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my design to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
